friction: run_plan mode=optimize timed out on the client after 60s (MCP tool timeout) although the server-side run kept going and completed in ~85s; I found the run_id and its status by polling get_provenance(plan_id), since run_plan returned no run_id.
get_results on an unfinished run returns 'Run not found' instead of a running status, so provenance is the only way to see progress.
get_results(summary=true) on an optimize run returned ~313k characters (full profiles), too large to read; I had to ask for named variables instead.
The reference doc does not list the mixed fuel/MTOW objective; I guessed the name 'mixed_objective' and it worked, and a test analysis confirmed it equals fuel burn + MTOW/100.

The structural weight factor (ac|weights|structural_fudge) set through initial_values is not echoed by get_results; I confirmed it takes effect by comparing OEW at factor 1.6 and 2.0 (2969.39 vs 3015.67 kg).
validate_plan accepted the plan before I knew whether the objective and constraint paths existed; a trial analysis run was needed to confirm them.
No tool gives an explicit SLSQP exit status or iteration count; I judged convergence from constraint feasibility and from the two different starts agreeing.
The optimum's max fuel capacity (500 kg lower bound) is below the fuel burned (530.28 kg); the task set no fuel-capacity constraint, so none was added.
